summary: Teardown of a two-part dynamic array block structure. Calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc on the global byte_5EA438, clears counters at +0x8 and +0x10, then frees each dynamic block if present: block 1 (+0xC) has 24-byte entries whose sub-pointers are StructEntryCleanup'd and freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf; block 2 (+0x14) has 680-byte entries whose field groups are passed to ShortComputation_4370. Both block headers are freed and their this pointers zeroed. Sets sentinel +0x20 to -1 and returns 0. Called by StructInitWithSentinels (004D7020), TireBrandFileParser (004D7150) and TextureSurfaceDestroyer (004D7800).

operations.description: Call StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (00566650) on the global byte_5EA438.
If the first block pointer (this+0xC) is non-null, tear down the first array block.
Iterate backwards over the 24-byte (6-dword) entries of the first block, seeded from its header count.
If the entry's first dword is non-null, free that sub-pointer.
Free each entry's sub-pointer via FreeWrapper_7bcf (00587BCF).
Free the first block's header allocation via FreeWrapper_7bcf (00587BCF).
Zero the first block pointer this+0xC to 0.
If the second block pointer (this+0x14) is non-null, tear down the second array block.
Iterate backwards over the 680-byte (170-dword) entries of the second block, seeded from its header count.
Call ShortComputation_4370 (00414370) on seven field groups of each 170-dword entry (offset +2, 0, -2, -80, -82, -84 and the entry start).
Free the second block's header allocation via FreeWrapper_7bcf (00587BCF).
Zero the second block pointer this+0x14 to 0.
Set sentinel at +0x20 to -1 to mark the cleaned state.
Invoked as a teardown path by StructInitWithSentinels (004D7020), TireBrandFileParser (004D7150) and TextureSurfaceDestroyer (004D7800).
